title: F-22 Raptor full-length demonstration at Miami Beach with flares
description: U.S. Air Force Capt. Nick “Laz” Le Tourneau, F-22 Raptor Aerial Demonstration Team commander, performs an aerial demonstration during the Hyundai Air and Sea show at Miami, Florida, May 24, 2025. The F-22 Aerial Demonstration Team highlights cutting-edge airpower, precision, skill, all while reinforcing public confidence in the Air Force’s ability to protect and defend. (U.S. Air Force video by Staff Sgt. Lauren Cobin)
credit: U.S. Air Force video by Staff Sgt. Lauren Cobin
